title: Commercial Solutions Opening Area of Interest for Computer Numerical Control Gantry Machining Center
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.ACC-CTRS.ACC-DTA.W6QK ACC ANAD
detail_text: This notice is issued as a related announcement under Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) W911KF-25-S-C002. This is an Area of Interest (AoI) for a Computer Numerical Control (CNC) Gantry Machining Center for Anniston Army Depot. Interested contractors must review and reference all requirements, instructions, and information contained in the original CSO posted on SAM.gov (and within this posting), as well as the details provided in the Area of Interest (AoI A004).
